fields.BWC_Benefit_Copy__c: {"BenefitCopy":[{"Feature":"Versatile Gas Burner Configuration","Copy":"Delivering exceptional cooking flexibility, the two 23,000-BTU multi-ring brass burners and dual-stack burners offer a range of heat settings, from gentle simmer to intense flame","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--DtPmWfIp--/70e12dba1d182da7c97d01efcf727940d80981ba.jpg","Video":"https://www.youtube.com/embed/inBSfYzpSjI"},{"Feature":"3-Piece Grates with Reversible Wok Feature","Copy":"Reversible grates are easy to clean and complement different culinary techniques, with a flat side for traditional cooking and contoured side that perfectly holds round-bottom woks","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--t-lfpqbh--/23d563466b2dfc9b602fe1d47ec5094d45c54eac.jpg"},{"Feature":"Ring-Lit Knobs","Copy":"Delivering a modern approach to accent lighting, the rings illuminate to indicate when a burner is in use","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--zXL9mCSD--/a0eae8d7c3a37d1410e92029bb7d366dabd5461a.jpg"},{"Feature":"Solid Brass Blades on Precision Machined Knobs","Copy":"With an unmatched attention to detail, all knobs on the new Monogram Pro ranges and range tops come with solid brass accents","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--D0qtcimC--/62d0ed808d2826732ade22c9e2393ce7b32e6347.jpg","Video":"https://www.youtube.com/embed/kBV77oPyto8"},{"Feature":"Solid Brass Burners","Copy":"Monogram burners are constructed of 100% brass, embracing the natural thermal properties of this premium quality material. As they are exposed to heat, a natural patina will build up to protect the burners from corrosion and ensure that your brass burners will withstand even the highest temperatures","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--OoH1JDHi--/8e6e45a2893f983217f6a0037986b7e9710b0503.jpg"},{"Feature":"Seamless Stainless Top Frame","Copy":"Meticulously crafted from one piece of stainless steel that covers the cooktop and control panel, this seamless and stylish surface is easy to clean and beautiful to look at","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--rX3kzRBH--/0d5255f1dd1bdbe608443dd329a11ac67289905a.jpg","Video":"https://www.youtube.com/embed/n-r1spKHX7E"},{"Feature":"LP Conversion Kit Included","Copy":"Designed to deliver a seamless conversion experience, this self-contained kit includes everything needed to convert a rangetop to liquid propane","Image":"https://products-salsify.geappliances.com/image/upload/s--9yrY-J4L--/c162e34a706df9465df4109da4b05fd2bfcb0078.jpg","Video":"https://www.youtube.com/embed/Lr6uaIs0K2E"}]}
